title: Let Them Stress You Out
coreMove: When a job stops being the only thing you stare at, your energy comes back for the resume, the calls, and the next move that actually belongs to you.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Boss Steve and the missing promotion
exampleSpecs.audience: Sasha and readers facing career agency under stress
exampleSpecs.stakes: Justified frustration becomes useful only when it points toward controllable professional action.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Sasha using career agency under stress in the source case without controlling another person.
